name: Absolute Zero Spring
description: Absolute Zero Spring is a small, frigid ice world far from its parent star, where temperatures hover near the theoretical minimum for planetary bodies. The surface is a perfectly smooth expanse of nitrogen ice, polished by solar wind erosion into a mirror-like finish that reflects the stars with startling clarity. Methane lakes occupy circular depressions that dot the surface in evenly spaced patterns, each one identical in diameter, as though stamped into the ice by a precise instrument.

The cold on Absolute Zero Spring is so extreme that standard environmental suit heating systems must operate at maximum capacity for even brief surface excursions. The thin atmosphere, barely more than a trace, carries no sound, and the smooth ice surface creates an illusion of floating in space, the reflected stars below indistinguishable from those above. Movement is treacherous on the frictionless ice, and the low gravity means falls are slow but recovery is complicated by the mirror-smooth terrain.

Temporal distortion zones have been detected in the crystal caverns beneath the surface, areas where time appears to slow to a crawl. Objects left in these zones age at a fraction of the normal rate, and the phenomenon has been tentatively linked to the extreme cold interacting with an unknown property of the crystalline matrix. The evenly spaced methane lakes are now believed to be surface expressions of the temporal zones, their perfect regularity reflecting the structured nature of the distortion field below.

Absolute Zero Spring has attracted interest as a potential preservation site, where materials or information could be stored in temporal stasis for effectively indefinite periods. The technical challenges of operating in such extreme cold are significant but not insurmountable, and several proposals for stasis vaults have been submitted. The regularity of the temporal zones suggests they are artificial rather than natural, raising questions about who created them and what might already be stored in the deepest, most time-dilated chambers that have not yet been reached.
